The '''Osskorn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tyan sector/Legends|Tyan sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the system to the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Tyan]] and [[Kwannot]], and it fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Osskorn Stout]] beverage.<ref name="DoG">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Osskorn Stout]]|system=Osskorn [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Osskorn system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-6.<ref name="TEA" />
